response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT o.orderspivot, o.recordvault AS ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS order_average_fill FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderspivot, o.recordvault, o.timespan), ranked AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, order_average_fill, AVG(order_average_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS time_in_force_average, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY (order_average_fill IS NULL), order_average_fill DESC) AS time_in_force_rank FROM per_order) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, order_average_fill, order_average_fill - time_in_force_average AS above_time_in_force_average, time_in_force_rank FROM ranked WHERE order_average_fill > time_in_force_average AND time_in_force_rank <= 3;

assumptions.assumption: The time-in-force average gives each matched order equal weight by averaging its per-order average fill.

alternatives.interpretation: The time-in-force average is calculated across all matched execution fill quantities, giving orders with more executions more weight.
